test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

At sea
solution:
The correct answer is **At a loss or perplexed.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate meaning of the given idiom is At a loss or perplexed.
 
• **At sea** means **bewildered, perplexed, or just plain confused.**
 
• Thus the correct answer is** **At a loss or perplexed.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **To overcome** means **to get the better of**.
 
• **Obsolete** means **outdated; no longer made or used.**
 
• **To blunder **means **a significant error typically brought on by carelessness or lack of consideration,**
